entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: It seems you've brought us a[n]Hecatoncheires with Masukunda.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: You completed all three tasks without[n]giving up! Nice work!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Not many tasks left.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: We might be getting close to finding out[n]the hidden goal behind that list.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: *snicker* Y'know thanks to you, I'm[n]actually starting to look forward to[n]seeing what happens.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Your attitude has shifted quite[n]considerably, Caroline.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: I see now that the harsh mask you wear[n]during the fusion ritual is nothing more[n]than a façade.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Wh-What!?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Perhaps in your heart, you have longed[n]for the days the Inmate would come to[n]fuse the specified Personas.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Th-That's not true!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: And what about YOU, Justine!? You've[n]been awful chatty lately!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: *chuckle* I suppose you are correct.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: I... I've never heard you laugh before,[n]Justine...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: We have both clearly changed quite a[n]bit recently.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Perhaps my hypothesis is true after all.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: We have thought that if we were to[n]complete the list, we would bring to[n]light the intent of its creator...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: We have overseen the inmate, all the[n]while considering the changes that[n]have begun to appear within him...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: However... can it truly be said that the[n]inmate is the only one who has changed?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: The completion of these tasks has[n]also had a great impact on both my[n]consciousness and my memories.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: No way, are you trying to say the list[n]isn't supposed to change the inmate...[n]but rather... ourselves!?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: I have no proof of that...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: However, if this list represented the will[n]of our master, why has it fallen into our[n]hands and not remained in his?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: This has gotta be some kinda joke. You're[n]telling me somebody made it... so they[n]could change... us?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: But... why?
You okay there?
Can I just have my reward?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Urgh... Wh-What's happening? I can[n]hear a voice... in my head...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: W-Wait, I recognize this voice! Urgh...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Caroline!?

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: What seems to be the matter? You are[n]behaving quite abnormally.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Does something trouble you?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: O-Our apologies, Master.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Is the inmate proving to be too horrible[n]a subject for you?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: No, the fault does not lie with him. If you[n]must reprimand anyone... let it be us.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Caroline...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: ...I see. Very well, continue onward with[n]his rehabilitation.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: ...Our deepest apologies for that brief[n]loss of composure.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Now then, as you have completed three[n]tasks, let us bestow upon you the next[n]reward.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: We will now grant you access to[n]the Guillotine Booster.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Think of it as a way to increase the[n]number of Personas you can make[n]with the Group Guillotine.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Plus, now you can perform some[n]extra-strong fusions using five or[n]six Personas.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: You should be able to figure it out with[n]some effort, Inmate. I mean, you've[n]come this far, right?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: We expect that you will put its services[n]to good use.
I feel like my bond with Caroline[n]and Justine is growing deeper...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Hmph. So I guess we've changed, huh?[n]That much is clear.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Strength... The eleventh arcana, which[n]near-evenly splits the major twenty-two...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: The awakening of the unknown...[n]A solitary woman calmly coming[n]to face a lion...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Caroline. Let us assign the inmate his[n]next task before we discuss this matter[n]any further.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: If this list is meant to change us, that[n]change must surely be important...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: ...Fine.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: All right, Inmate! It's time for your[n]new task!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Oh, and your next reward is gonna be[n]incredible, so you've gotta do two tasks[n]before you can have it!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Accordingly, these next two shall be[n]the most difficult you have faced to[n]this point.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: On to the first assignment before your[n]next reward...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Try to obtain a Bugs with Samarecarm.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: We'll be waiting for you—though I know[n]you won't give up just 'cause it's hard!
